rows.name: escape-ud800
rows.source: set c "\ud800";list [string length $c] [string range $c 1 end] [string equal [string index $c 0] "\ufffd"]

rows.name: escape-udfff
rows.source: set c "\udfff";list [string length $c] [string range $c 1 end] [string equal [string index $c 0] "\ufffd"]

rows.name: escape-U0000d800

rows.name: escape-U0001f600

rows.name: escape-U00110000

rows.name: escape-U10000000

rows.name: surrogate-roundtrip
rows.source: set x 😀;set a [string index $x 0];set b [string index $x 1];list [string length $a] [string length $b] [string equal $a$b $x] [string equal [string range $x 0 0] $a] [string equal [string reverse A${x}B] B${x}A]

rows.name: surrogate-replace
rows.source: set x 😀;set a [string index $x 0];set b [string index $x 1];list [string equal [string replace $x 0 0 X] X$b] [string equal [string map [list $a X] $x] X$b] [string first $b $x 1] [string last $a $x 0] [string equal -length 1 $x $a]

rows.name: surrogate-trim
rows.source: set x 😀;set a [string index $x 0];set b [string index $x 1];list [string equal [string trim $x $a] $b] [string equal [string reverse $a] $a]

rows.name: case-mapping-no-expansion
rows.source: list [string toupper ßﬀ] [string tolower İ] [string totitle ǳABC] [string map -nocase {İ X ß Y} iİßSS] [lsort -nocase {İ i ß ss SS}] [lsearch -nocase -exact {SS ß İ} i]
rows.result: ßﬀ i ǲabc XXYSS {İ i ss SS ß} -1

rows.name: georgian-title
rows.source: list [string totitle ᲐᲑᲒ] [string totitle აᲑᲒ] [string tolower ᲐᲑᲒ]

rows.name: case-byte-growth
rows.source: list [string toupper ɐɜ] [string tolower ȺȾ] [string equal -nocase Ⱥ ⱥ] [string match -nocase Ⱥ ⱥ] [string map -nocase {Ⱥ X} ⱥ]

rows.name: unicode-variable-names
rows.source: set 中文 3;set a(中) 4;list [subst {$中文}] [subst {${中文}}] [subst {$a(中)}] [expr {${中文}+1}]

rows.source: list [string first x axbx end-1] [string first x axbx end]
